title: Louisiana Contractor License Status
description: Check public contractor license records from the Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors. Search by license number or company name. Each lookup costs $0.02 after Store publication; source outages are not charged. Verify directly with the board before relying on a record.

license_number.title: License number
license_number.description: Louisiana contractor license number, such as CL.68755 or RL.883684. Use this or Company name for one lookup.

name.title: Company name
name.description: Search for a company-name substring in Louisiana contractor records (at least 3 characters).

max_results.title: Maximum matching licenses
max_results.description: Maximum license records returned for a company-name search; capped at 10.

queries.title: Batch lookups
queries.description: Optional batch of up to 100 JSON search objects, each with license_number or name and optional max_results. Each input object is one billed lookup.
